audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer repeats a fabricated ability name "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" nine times (tldr/winCon/enemyWin/breakdown.cooldowns/loading/focus.text/dosFull[2].d/report[5].t/report[9].t). Hwei has no ability called Subject: Fear — his E is Subject: Torment, and its fear component is Grim Visage (verified: Grim Visage fears the first champion hit, confirmed via League Wiki). Content layer also names a nonexistent "Disdain (W-E)" and "Stumbling Blast (E)" — real abilities are Fleeting Current (WQ, his reposition/speed stream) and Grim Visage (EQ, the fear/zone tool).
audit.why: A reader who plays Hwei will spot the wrong name immediately, and the advice ("dodge the paint") points at a spell that doesn't exist.
audit.corrected: Replace every "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" with "Grim Visage (Fear)"; replace "Disdain (W-E)" with "Fleeting Current (WQ)" and "Stumbling Blast (E)" with "Grim Visage (EQ)".
sources: WebSearch: League Wiki Grim Visage (Hwei E-Q) fears first champion hit
WebSearch: Fleeting Current (Hwei W-Q) speed stream reposition tool

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side and phases[1].side both say "Hwei" while content win[0]/win[1] say "Renata" and the why text under both rows already describes a Renata-favoring trade — the two layers argue with themselves. phases[2..5].side are the unfilled "Skill" placeholder while content win[2..5] all say "Hwei", and those rows' why text still describes Renata winning (e.g. "Hostile Takeover online... you can weaponize" at level 6, when Hwei's own Spiraling Despair is what wins that level).
audit.why: packet.levelChart (Renata,Renata,Hwei,Hwei,Hwei,Hwei,Renata) matches content win[] exactly, confirming win[] is the correct chart and the full layer is stale/unfilled.
